key_insight: LLM agents alone are unreliable for complex MBPT workflows, but a knowledge-engineered, deterministic framework can make GW, GW-BSE, and GWPT calculations fully runnable and consistent.
engineering_relevance: This work shows that high-fidelity computational materials pipelines can be made agentic without sacrificing correctness by encoding expert knowledge and enforcing deterministic execution.
method: Benchmarked out-of-the-box LLM agents on GW, GW-BSE, and GWPT workflow construction.
Built AI-Donkey, combining expert-curated domain knowledge with deterministic software orchestration.
Validated autonomous calculations and post-processing across 1D, 2D, and bulk materials.
evidence_signal: Across tested model-harness combinations, out-of-the-box agents averaged 54% on GW, 36% on GW-BSE, and 19% on GWPT, with large run-to-run variation; AI-Donkey removed observed variation and produced complete runnable workflows.
watch_item: Performance depends on curated domain knowledge and deterministic setup, so the framework may require substantial expert maintenance when software stacks or protocols change.
paper_title: Enabling large language model agents for high-fidelity many-body perturbation theory calculations
